title: fix(console): an access_denied sign-in return says the account has no access to this environment, with switch account and back to console
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQcmeMn9B7V1fsuBruqyWzH)_

Fixes #32992

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:环境的登录页收到 `?error=access_denied`(#33325 合并后,控制面身份提供方拒绝非成员账号时就这样把浏览器送回环境)时,不再说「登录链接已过期」,而是说账号无权访问(英文 "does not have access to this environment",中文「你登录所用的账号无权访问本系统」,共 11 种语言)。在由控制面托管的环境上,横幅下多两个动作:「切换账号」在新标签页打开控制面的 `/api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session`,真正退出提供方那边被拒的账号;「返回控制台」回到控制面控制台。
- 为什么改:用户在环境里退出、换一个非成员账号登录后,服务端半边已经把原始 JSON 换成了 `access_denied` 回跳,但环境登录页仍显示通用的过期链接文案,也没有下一步。
- 风险与回滚:只改 Console 登录页一个错误码的文案和两个链接,其余错误码不变;非托管环境只显示文案、不显示链接(那里错误码可能来自页面无法寻址的提供方)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` 的 `accessDeniedExits`(决定何时给链接、链接指向哪里);`LoginPage.tsx` 的 `AccessDeniedActions`;`__tests__/LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`**: `access_denied` (RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1) gets its own sentence, `auth.login.errors.ssoAccessDenied`: "The account you signed in with does not have access to this environment. Sign in with an account that has access, or ask an administrator of this environment's organization to add you as a member." It says what #33325's 403 page says ("…does not have access to this environment", "An administrator of the environment's organization can add you as a member"). New `accessDeniedExits({ code, cloudManaged, cloudBase })` answers the two ways on, or `null`:
  - only for `access_denied`, only on an environment the control plane runs (`features.cloudManaged === true` from `/auth/config`), and only when the runtime config names the control plane (`cloudUrl`, an absolute http(s) URL);
  - **Switch account** = `${cloudUrl}/api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session`, the provider's RP-initiated logout, the same door #33325's page links;
  - **Back to console** = `cloudUrl`, the control plane's console (the same origin `cloudConsoleUrl()` already links for billing and storage).
- **`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`**: under the refusal banner, `AccessDeniedActions` draws the two links and a one-line hint. Switch account opens in a new tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`): the provider ends the session and then stays on its own "Logged out." page, so this page stays put with the sign-in below it. The technical code and description stay behind the details toggle.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: four keys under `auth.login.errors` (`ssoAccessDenied`, `ssoSwitchAccount`, `ssoBackToConsole`, `ssoSwitchAccountHint`) in en, de, es, fr, pt-BR, ru, ja, ko, ar, zh-Hans, and zh-Hant (regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`). zh says 本系统, not 此环境, under the objectui#12956 rule (`console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts`); de names the action without „…“ so the quote census stays at its pinned counts.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32992-access-denied-sign-in-return.md`: `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, with both declaration lines.

No server, plugin-auth or `packages/spec` file is touched.

## Why switch account is the provider's end-session door

The refusal comes before any session on the environment exists, so signing out of the environment changes nothing: the refused account is still signed in at the identity provider, and the next sign-in would hand it straight back. The ways measured on `origin/main` `bd439f17`:

- **The provider's end-session door** (`@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12, `rpInitiatedLogoutEndpoint`): a browser navigation with no `id_token_hint` and a live provider session gets the vendor's "Confirm logout" page; its POST to `/oauth2/end-session/confirm` deletes that session (`deleteLogoutSession`) and clears the cookie. That really changes who is signed in. It is mounted on every runtime with the provider (`GET /api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session` in plugin-auth's `auth-route-ledger.ts`). **Used.**
- **`prompt=login` on a fresh sign-in**: the provider sends the browser to its login page, but the control plane's Console `LoginPage` sees the session that is still signed in and replays the authorize request at once (`followOauthAuthorize`), so it loops back to the same refusal. Not used.
- **`client_id` + `post_logout_redirect_uri`** on the end-session door would bring the person back here, but only if the environment's client is registered with `enable_end_session` and that exact URI. The page cannot know either (the client id is server config), and a client without `enable_end_session` gets the vendor's 401 error page. Not used; see Acceptance notes.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx`, driven through the real `LoginPage` with the server's `/auth/config` through the auth client and the control plane's address through `initRuntimeConfig()` (as at boot):
  1. `?error=access_denied&error_description=…&state=…` on a managed environment: the alert is the new sentence (not the generic one), the description stays in the toggle, the **Switch account** link's `href` is `https://cloud.example.test/api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session` with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, **Back to console** is `https://cloud.example.test`, and the sign-in form is still on the page.
  2. The same under direct sign-in: the two actions and the "Continue with single sign-on" retry are both there (no loop).
  3. Off the control plane (`features: {}`): the new sentence, and no actions.
  4. **CONTROL**: `?error=invalid_provider` on a managed environment keeps the generic sentence and offers no actions.
- The existing `LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx` and `LoginPage.direct-sign-in.test.tsx` (which already drive `access_denied`) pass unchanged.
- Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, implementation committed first, restore proven: blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty each time; console tests import `src`, so no build leg):
  - mapping deleted (`access_denied: ACCESS_DENIED,` removed): cases 1, 2 and 3 red (3 failed, 1 passed);
  - managed gate removed (`input.cloudManaged !== true` → never true): case 3 red (1 failed, 3 passed);
  - actions not rendered in `LoginPage`: cases 1 and 2 red (2 failed, 2 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the actions show.** Only where `features.cloudManaged` is true and the runtime config names the control plane. On a self-hosted deployment, or for an `access_denied` from an enterprise identity provider, the page cannot address the provider that refused, so it shows the sentence alone and keeps the sign-in below it; no link to the wrong provider.
- **The switch takes one more step than a single click.** Without `id_token_hint` the provider asks the person to confirm, and without a registered `post_logout_redirect_uri` it ends on its own "Logged out." page; that is why the page opens it in a new tab and says to sign in here again afterwards. A one-click round trip would need the environment's client registered with `enable_end_session` and this page's URI as a `post_logout_redirect_uri`, plus the client id served to the page. That is a server and control-plane change, recorded in the report's `out_of_scope_findings`, not made here.
- **The path is composed** from `cloudUrl` plus the framework's fixed auth mount (`/api/v1/auth`), the same composition `cloud-connection` already makes for `${cloudUrl}/api/v1/auth/device/code`. Not measured live against cloud staging: this session has no cloud access.
- `access_denied` is also what the provider sends when a person declines a consent screen. Environment clients skip consent, so on this path it means the account was refused; the sentence would read slightly off only for a consent-declining client, which lands here with the description in the toggle.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: four new keys per published `@object-ui/i18n` pack; nothing renamed or removed. No new export from any package.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local tests and gates (head 77593a13)</summary>

- Engine dists the ui suites read: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/formula...' --filter '@objectstack/spec...' --filter '@objectstack/client...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/sdui-parser...' build` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0; console closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project @object-ui/console --maxWorkers=2` (from `ui/`): Test Files 313 passed (313), Tests 3217 passed (3217), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/`: Test Files 135 passed (135), Tests 2218 passed, 13 skipped. The first run (before 77593a13) was red on `console-copy-system-noun-12956` (zh 此环境) and `de-quote-pairing-3876` (counts); both fixed in 77593a13.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the three touched console files: 0 errors; the 3 warnings in `LoginPage.tsx` are the same 3 the file has on `origin/main`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 38 families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The locale fix landed while the loop ran, so the families that read locale files were run again on 77593a13, all exit 0: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`.

</details>

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files passes (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
